subject: Any thoughts on the sign-up page?
text: I wanted to ask for your honest feedback on the new sign-up page before we finish this week's small changes. Since you are a new client, your first impressions would be really useful, especially if anything felt unclear or slightly annoying. I know the upload button was acting a little stubborn yesterday, so I would also appreciate hearing whether it behaved better for you today. There is no pressure to be thorough; even a few short sentences would help. I am trying to make sure the process feels simple for people who are joining from a phone or a slower connection. If you noticed a confusing label, a slow step, or a message that made you pause, please mention it. The goal is not to fix everything at once, but to understand what stood out while your visit was still fresh.
